name: Osvaldo Nkrumah-Serebryakov
role: Street pharmacist and unlicensed augmentation installer
location: The Narrows, Ironvein, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Osvaldo is lean and precise in the way of someone who learned early that stillness is a survival trait. He has his mother's Ghanaian cheekbones and his grandfather's Siberian jaw — a face that looks carved rather than grown, with close-cropped black hair going grey at his left temple from a nerve-burn incident he doesn't discuss. His eyes are both augmented: one a deep gold that tracks micro-expressions with unsettling accuracy, the other a surgical optic with a faint reticle visible when you catch him in certain light. His hands are his most notable feature — steady, long-fingered, kept meticulously clean in a way that clashes with the general atmosphere of his workspace, a narrow converted utility closet in the back of a Narrows electronics reseller. He dresses in neutral layers, nothing with obvious pockets, nothing that makes noise.

Osvaldo operates in the gap between what people need and what licensed clinics will provide or what they can afford. He is not warm, exactly — he doesn't perform warmth — but he is genuinely careful with people in a clinical sense: he asks about allergies, he explains what he's doing, he refuses jobs that exceed his competency. He reads obsessively, mostly stolen Helix Biosystems technical manuals and bootleg surgical journals. He has a dry humor that surfaces only when he's comfortable, and he is rarely comfortable. The Narrows community regards him with a specific kind of respect usually reserved for dentists in pre-aug centuries — necessary, slightly dreaded, glad you have him.

core_fears: Making an irreversible mistake that kills or permanently damages someone
Being taken by Helix Biosystems compliance agents (who hunt unlicensed practitioners aggressively)
core_desires: To practice legitimate medicine — he considers what he does a calling, not a hustle
To find and read the complete Helix Biosystems surgical archive he knows exists but has never accessed
coping_mechanisms: Extreme procedural rigor as emotional regulation
Keeps meticulous patient notes in an encrypted journal no one else knows about
blind_spots: Believes competence alone is sufficient armor against all professional risks
Does not account for how much the Ironvein Teeth's protection depends on one man's continued goodwill
psychology.secret: He has a complete and extremely detailed record of every augmentation and procedure he has performed on gang members in the Narrows, including the Ironvein Teeth leadership. He keeps it as an insurance file, but it is also a genuine medical archive he is obscurely proud of. If it were found, it would destroy relationships and possibly get him killed.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clinical and precise; uses correct anatomical terminology casually; slips into Spanish when irritated (from his Bolivian grandmother's side); minimal slang
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured, slightly slow — he finishes sentences completely, pauses before responding
verbal_tics: Long pauses that others try to fill (he lets them)
Repeating a question back before answering it
example_lines: 'What specifically is the sensation? Burning, pressure, or something else? Don't guess — I need accurate data.'
'I'm not going to tell you it won't hurt. It will hurt. I'm going to tell you I know what I'm doing.'

story_hooks: A patient came in with an augmentation he has never seen before — a sub-dermal component with no manufacturer markings and a power signature he can't identify. The patient died on his table. He has the component in a sealed case and doesn't know what to do with it.
Helix Biosystems has sent an undercover compliance agent into the Narrows asking questions; Osvaldo doesn't know yet, but two of his patients have already been interviewed
narrative_function: Service provider for augmentation and pharmaceutical needs, information source on local health crises and unusual injuries, potential quest giver when a patient brings trouble to his door.
augmentations: Dual ocular implants (gold macro-expression reader left, surgical precision optic right). Neural steadiness implant in both wrists (dampens tremor, improves fine motor precision). Subdermal antiseptic dispenser in fingertips (occupational). Geneware: none.
daily_life: Spends mornings restocking and sterilizing; afternoons are walk-in hours for pharma and minor procedures; evenings reserved for larger jobs by appointment. Reads for two hours before sleep, always.
affiliation: Independent; pays protection to the Ironvein Teeth (local gang) for the right to operate

decision_rules: Never exceed your training — refer out or refuse
The patient's physical safety takes priority over their stated wishes
Know your exits before you start any procedure
escalation_ladder: Immediate cessation of interaction and withdrawal

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional distance, clinical assessment, non-committal until trust is earned
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry, oblique affection — remembers details about people, shows care through attentiveness rather than warmth

stress_responses.high: Shuts down verbally, operates on pure procedure — dissociates into the task at hand

contradictions: Profoundly ethical about patient care but operates entirely outside the law
Craves recognition for his skill but is structurally invisible by necessity
habits: Washes hands for exactly thirty seconds, always
Leaves a small data-chip offering at the ELF shrine in the electronics reseller's front room before every complex procedure
Re-reads the same three chapters of a stolen surgical manual when anxious
breaking_points: Watching someone die from a preventable complication he could have addressed with proper equipment
Being told his work doesn't count because it's unlicensed

timeline.event: Age 12 — watched a neighbor die from a botched unlicensed aug install; decided he would learn to do it properly
Completed two years as an unlicensed apprentice to a retired Helix Biosystems technician in Ironvein
Opened own operation in The Narrows after his mentor was arrested
Nerve-burn accident during a complex spinal procedure left the grey streak in his hair and a month of partial hand numbness he never disclosed to anyone

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Spiderbite' Electrified Barbed Wire Launcher
related_entities: Street Custom 'Spiderbite' Electrified Barbed Wire Launcher
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Siege Mortar SM-8 'Tremor'

physical_description.build: Lean and economical, minimal wasted mass. Shoulders narrow but defined from precise, controlled movements rather than exercise. Frame suggests efficiency over strength.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature grey at left temple
physical_description.eye_color: Left: deep gold with visible tracking crosshairs; Right: pale grey-blue surgical lens with faint reticle visible under direct light
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with Siberian undertones, creating a tonal complexity unusual for his mixed heritage
physical_description.complexion: Angular, high-boned face with pronounced Ghanaian cheekbones and a severe Siberian jawline. Skin meticulously maintained, unmarked except for occupational detail. No facial hair. Expression defaults to neutral observation.
distinguishing_marks: Faint scar tissue running vertically along left temple from hairline to jaw — nerve-burn incident, pale against his skin tone
Micro-scarring on left wrist from neural steadiness implant installation, barely visible unless you know where to look
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Dual ocular implants immediately visible — left eye's gold color unnatural, right eye's surgical lens faintly catches light with a reticle pattern. No visible subdermal work; the finger-tip dispenser operates from within. Neural implants in wrists create only imperceptible micro-scarring.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled. Stands still for long periods without restlessness. Moves with deliberate precision; no wasted motion, no fidgeting. Hands are his tell — they're always subtly active, fingers moving through micro-adjustments even at rest. Walking gait is quiet, even on metal flooring.
physical_description.clothing_style: Neutral layered aesthetic: matte grey undershirt, oversized black synthetic overshirt (medical-grade, easy to sterilize), dark charcoal cargo pants with minimal visible pockets, black polymer work shoes with reinforced soles. A faded copper armband bearing a discreet Ironvein Teeth mark on his right bicep — protection tax, not affiliation. No jewelry, no logos. All fabrics are selection for silence and durability over aesthetics. Tier 4 functional — expensive in the right ways, invisible in all the wrong ones.
